plain_english: Of supreme-light-bodied, reflection-power, O Lord — supreme goddess. Hers indeed spread — all Brahmī-led goddesses.
sanskrit_cite: paramaprakāśavapuṣo vimarśaśaktiḥ prabho parā devī | asyā eva prasaraḥ sarvā brāhmyādikā devyaḥ

plain_english: Fire-water-nectar-streak-poison-bearing, You point this. World opposed though — in true-consciousness-formed, in me unopposed — not this.
sanskrit_cite: dahanajalāmṛtalekhāviṣādi bibhrat tvam ādiśasy etat | viśvaṃ viruddham api saccidrūpe mayi virudhyate naitat

plain_english: Knowing-thread-dissolved, sapless knower-host, this — skull-garland-of-faculties-bearing, You show thus, as-if, to us, O Lord.
sanskrit_cite: saṃvitsūtranilīno niḥsāro mātṛnivaho 'yam | karaṇamuṇḍamālabhārin darśayasītīva naḥ svāmin

plain_english: See, see — adverse nooses — those, these expelled ever. Thus entrail-holding-as-if, saying, to us appear.
sanskrit_cite: paśyata paśyata pāśā viṣamās ta ime bahiṣkṛtāḥ śaśvat | antradhāraṇamiṣat kathayaṃs tvaṃ naḥ samābhāsi

plain_english: Māyā-cloth passionate in supreme heaven — in this that this cast. Thus elephant-hide bloody on head bearing — You tell, O Lord.
sanskrit_cite: māyāpaṭaḥ sarāgo vyomni pare 'smin sa eṣa nikṣiptaḥ | gajacarma saraktaṃ mūrdhni vahan kathayasīśa

plain_english: Inner-power-dagger bared — saṃsāra-splitting — by sword. All-world-by-own-power-glory-taken indeed — best heroes.
sanskrit_cite: antaḥśaktikṛpāṇīm vyanakṣi saṃsṛtivibhedinīm asinā | nijaśaktimahimasvīkṛtasamastaviśvā hi vīravarāḥ

plain_english: World-fear-killer — he, I, in lordship established, am — fear not. Thus by shield-clash-showing, You point us, O Lord.
sanskrit_cite: bhavabhayahantā so 'ham sānāthye 'vasthito 'smi | mā bhaiṣṭa ity āsphoṭitakheṭakadarśanato diśasi naḥ svāmin

plain_english: Own-power-noose-bound, by consciousness-body, time is counted by me. Thus by noose-holding, You show us death-of-death — You.
sanskrit_cite: nijaśaktipāśavalitaś cidvapuṣā kalyate mayā kālaḥ | pāśadhāraṇavaśāt prathayasi naḥ kālakālas tvam

plain_english: Distinction-made, all, this, by own power indeed I hurl to destroy. Thus by goad-holding, supreme Bhairava makes plain to us.
sanskrit_cite: bhedamayam akhilam etan nijaśaktyaivākṣipāmi saṃhartum | aṅkuśadhāraṇataḥ sphuṭayati parabhairavo 'smākam

plain_english: By bow-mounted-arrow-showing, Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Rudra-lords with Sadākhya-Śivas — by power, cause-deer pierced like a deer — You.
sanskrit_cite: kodaṇḍārūdhaśarapradarśanād | brahmaviṣṇurudreśān sasadākhyaśivāñ chaktyā kāraṇahariṇaṃ bhinatsi mṛgavat tvam
